title: BUS Grants Boosted
Off-Gas Grid & Air-to-Air
sub: Enhanced Boiler Upgrade Scheme grants target off-gas grid homes and include air-to-air systems.

items.label: Max grant for off-gas grid homes

rows.label: Increased grants of £9,000 for off-gas grid properties.
Air-to-air heat pumps now eligible for £2,500 grants.
EPC insulation recommendations no longer a barrier.
Scheme extended until at least 2030, installer-led.

sections.title: Strategic Impact
lines: Broadens low-carbon heating access for UK homes.
